messages:
Rae: Quick thread: follow-up to the onprem packaging RFC 7. We need a simple contract for 'tombstone' lifecycle in air-gapped nodes. Hard deletes are risky. Thoughts?
Jun: Agreed: tombstone + metadata lease. Keep blobs around until lease expires or admin revokes.
Maya: Add explicit backreference counts so we never GC something still referenced by a pinned rollout. Also expose `local-store --list --show-pins` for operators.
Rae: Proposal: three states: active, tombstoned, purged. Tombstoned => invisible to normal ops but present for rollback and validation. Purged => binary deleted.
Jun: And require a signed admin override file for purge in airgap. No network ops should be sufficient to purge without offline approval.
Maya: On activation we must validate all blob checksums and return ERR_MISSING_BLOBS if any are absent. No silent fallbacks.
ops-bot: note: RFC patch queued: onprem-tombstone-lifecycle-v1.1.md.
Rae: Action items: Jun: spec override file format; Maya: CLI UX + backref endpoint; I'll update RFC with state machine. Ping here when done.
